FAS Torgi car make/model picker data

Vehicle data by VehiclesDB — https://vehiclesdb.com
Dataset version: 2026.11.10
Pinned upstream commit: e9a8711aeb92f8b2e5ab2331cff30931d30ba072
Retrieved: 2026-11-12

Changes made for FAS Torgi: selected car and van records; removed specifications, availability and popularity; merged duplicate make/model names; removed obvious non-model/register cross-brand labels and a misspelling (details in car-catalog-source.json); normalized whitespace; added Russian aliases and current Russia-market factual model names from manufacturer model-lineup pages. Only names were curated from those pages; no descriptions, images or specifications were copied. This adapted catalog is distributed under CC-BY 4.0.

Coverage: a broad register-derived make/model catalog, not a guarantee of every vehicle ever made. Rare or newer vehicles may need manual entry.

Official factual-name supplement sources:
- EXEED: https://exeed.ru/cars/
- Belgee: https://belgee.ru/about-belgee/
- Solaris: https://solaris.auto/about-brand
- KNEWSTAR: https://knewstar.ru/models/
- TENET: https://tenet.ru/customers/configurator/
- LADA: https://www.lada.ru/press-releases/122334
- Москвич: https://moskvich.ru/models
- Geely: https://shop.geely-motors.com/catalog/models/
- Haval: https://haval.ru/about/media/prodazhi-gwm-v-rossii-pokazali-uverennyi-rost-vo-vtorom-kvartale-2026-goda/

## Crediting VehiclesDB (required)

Attribution is a CONDITION of the CC-BY 4.0 license (§3(a)) — every
public use of this data must visibly credit VehiclesDB with a link.
The form we request:

> Vehicle data by [VehiclesDB](https://vehiclesdb.com)

- **Website**: a visible, followable link — e.g. in your footer:
  `<a href="https://vehiclesdb.com">Vehicle data by VehiclesDB</a>`
- **App / no website**: name us in the app description or an
  about/credits screen: "Vehicle data by VehiclesDB (vehiclesdb.com)".
- **Papers / datasets**: cite the repo URL and the version you used.

The upstream notices below are UNCONDITIONAL: they discharge the
source registers' own license terms (OGL v3, CC-BY, dl-de/by-2-0)
and apply to every consumer of this data, under every VehiclesDB
license, commercial included.

The VehiclesDB dataset (CC-BY 4.0) is reconciled from the following
official sources. Each license's prescribed statement is reproduced
verbatim as required (CC-BY 4.0 §3(a); OGL v3; and siblings).

## Australian registered road vehicles by make and model (BITRE Road Vehicles Australia)

- Source: https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/road-vehicles-australia-january-2025
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/)
- Statement: © Commonwealth of Australia 2025. Source: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE), Road vehicles Australia, January 2025 (data.gov.au), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). VehiclesDB aggregated, normalised and reconciled these counts to its make/model records; this is not endorsed by BITRE or the Commonwealth.

## German new car registrations by make and model series (KBA FZ10)

- License: [Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0](https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0)
- Statement: Datenquelle: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (KBA), Neuzulassungen von Personenkraftwagen nach Marken und Modellreihen (FZ 10); dl-de/by-2-0. Data reconciled/normalized by VehiclesDB (changes marked per license).

## German vehicle fleet and Lkw registrations by manufacturer and trade name (KBA FZ 2.2, FZ 2.8, FZ 4.8)

- License: [Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0](https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0)
- Statement: Datenquelle: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (KBA), Bestand an Personenkraftwagen (FZ 2.2) und an Nutzfahrzeugen (FZ 2.8) nach Herstellern und Handelsnamen sowie Neuzulassungen von Lastkraftwagen nach Herstellern und Handelsnamen (FZ 4.8); dl-de/by-2-0. Data reconciled/normalized by VehiclesDB (changes marked per license).

## US EPA/DOE fuel economy vehicle catalog (fueleconomy.gov)

- Source: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/download.shtml
- License: [US Government public domain (17 USC §105)](https://www.energy.gov/web-policies)
- Statement: Contains US EPA/DOE fuel economy data (fueleconomy.gov), a US Government work in the public domain; DOE acknowledged as requested.

Modifications: VehiclesDB normalizes, reconciles, and curates the raw
records (make/model string normalization, deduplication, taxonomy
assignment). Counts are transformed into ranks/deciles. Errors are ours,
not the sources'.

## Additional vehicle coverage — 13 November 2026

The pinned VehiclesDB truck and bus catalogs have been merged with the existing car and van catalogs. The original VehiclesDB and upstream notices above apply unchanged. Model-level vehicleTypes distinguish passenger cars from trucks/buses.

Chinese model-name supplements contain factual names only, verified from manufacturer, representative or market model pages; no photographs, product descriptions or commercial price data are reproduced. The source manifest lists each nameplate and checked URL. This broad catalog is not an exhaustive guarantee; manual entry remains available.
